notes: A fresh, calmer look across the app: Ask, Spaces, Reports, Sources, People, Model, Agent mode, Updates and your Account
Deep analysis suggests deeper questions; Chart mode always offers at least three charts to start from
Only people with your company's email domain can be invited, or switch their sign-in email
Every connector shows how far a sync has got: "12 of 40 issues done"
Connecting a tool that is not set up yet opens a step-by-step guide instead of an error
Updates shows which version you are running
Exact answers and charts over large spreadsheets: every tab, totals over thousands of rows, two sheets compared
Every question is answered fresh; a new Redis-compatible service holds rate limits only
The Google Forms survey picker is gone from Sources
New installer: the first run creates .env, your team fills it in, the second run starts Handbook
Any AI model provider: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible service
When Handbook cannot start, the installer names the setting to fix
Your company is created during installation; colleagues join by invite
Admins are told about new versions and can update from Admin › Updates
